summary: Lets employees assemble an expense report from scanned receipts and corporate card transactions, then routes it for manager approval automatically.
Extracts merchant, amount, and date from a photographed receipt using OCR and pre-fills the expense line so employees rarely type totals by hand.
Flags expense line items that exceed policy limits or are missing required documentation before the report reaches an approver's queue.
Syncs daily corporate card transactions into employee expense queues so charges are pre-populated instead of manually entered.
Gives managers a single queue of pending expense reports awaiting their sign-off, with bulk approve and delegate-while-away options.
Generates customer invoices from contract and usage data and delivers them by email or portal on the agreed billing cycle.
Automates recurring subscription billing, prorating mid-cycle plan changes and retrying failed charges on a configurable schedule.
Lets billing support agents review a customer's disputed invoice line by line and issue a partial credit without leaving the console.
Manages customer credit limits and payment terms, holding new orders when an account exceeds its approved credit exposure.
Gives business customers a self-service portal to view past invoices, download statements, and update their billing contact.
Routes each payment attempt to the processor most likely to authorize it based on card type, region, and historical approval rates.
Reconciles daily settlement files from each processor against expected transaction totals, flagging shortfalls for the finance team.
Processes customer refund requests against the original payment method and tracks refund status until funds are confirmed returned.
Stores customer card details as secure tokens so downstream systems can charge a saved payment method without ever touching raw card numbers.
Schedules and batches outbound payouts to marketplace sellers or partners on a configurable payout calendar, holding payouts that fail a risk check.
Scores each incoming transaction for fraud risk in real time and blocks or holds the ones above a configurable threshold before authorization.
Gives fraud analysts a case workflow to investigate flagged transactions, gather evidence, and record a final disposition.
Lets the fraud team author and test new detection rules against historical transaction data before pushing them into production scoring.
Watches for unusual spikes in transaction velocity from a single account or device and raises an alert before losses accumulate.
Tracks incoming chargebacks from dispute to resolution, compiling the evidence packet needed to represent a transaction to the card network.
The system of record for journal entries and account balances across every business unit, feeding the monthly close process.
Matches bank statement lines against recorded transactions automatically, surfacing only the exceptions that need manual review.
Lets accountants draft, review, and post manual journal entries with a built-in approval step for anything above a materiality threshold.
Matches intercompany transactions between subsidiaries so consolidated reporting eliminates them cleanly at period close.
Tracks every task in the monthly close calendar with owners and due dates, giving controllers a real-time view of close progress.
Gives department heads a spreadsheet-like workbook to submit their annual budget requests that rolls up automatically into the company total.
Updates a rolling twelve-month revenue and expense forecast each month using the latest actuals, replacing the static annual budget view.
Compares actual spend against budget by department and highlights variances beyond a set percentage for finance business partners to investigate.
Lets analysts model best-case, base-case, and downside revenue scenarios side by side and see the impact on cash runway.
Routes submitted department budgets through a multi-level approval chain before they're locked in as the year's operating plan.
Tracks every jurisdiction's filing deadline the company owes a return in and reminds the tax team well ahead of each due date.
Looks up the correct sales and use tax rate for a transaction based on ship-to address and product taxability rules.
Stores and validates customer tax exemption certificates so exempt sales are correctly excluded from tax calculation at checkout.
Monitors sales activity by state to flag when the company crosses an economic nexus threshold requiring new tax registration.
Organizes the documentation a tax auditor requests during an examination, letting the tax team respond to information requests from one place.
Calculates and processes each pay period's payroll run, applying deductions and generating pay stubs for every employee.
Pulls approved hourly timesheets from the workforce management system into payroll so hours don't need to be re-entered manually.
Calculates federal, state, and local tax withholding for each employee's paycheck based on their W-4 elections and work location.
Lets employees add or update their direct deposit bank accounts and split pay across multiple accounts by percentage or fixed amount.
Processes off-cycle payments like bonuses and correction runs outside the normal payroll calendar with the right tax treatment applied.
Scores commercial loan applicants using financial statement and bureau data to recommend an approval tier and credit limit.
Tracks the financial health of key trading counterparties and alerts risk managers when a counterparty's rating deteriorates.
Aggregates exposure across the entire lending portfolio by risk tier, industry, and geography for the risk committee's review.
Monitors borrower compliance with loan covenants and flags any breach as soon as updated financials are submitted.
Combines payment behavior and external signals to flag accounts trending toward default well before they miss a payment.
Aggregates balances across every bank account each morning so treasury can see the company's global cash position at a glance.
Tracks the company's exposure to foreign currency movements across subsidiaries and suggests hedges to reduce volatility.
Maintains the master record of every corporate bank account, its signers, and its authorized purpose across the organization.
Projects cash inflows and outflows over the coming quarter to help treasury decide when to draw or repay the revolving credit line.
Tracks principal and interest payment schedules across all outstanding debt instruments and alerts treasury ahead of each due date.
Assembles the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement from ledger data each period, ready for controller review.
Pulls the latest financial results into a pre-formatted board presentation template, cutting hours off quarterly board prep.
Displays the company's key financial metrics, like gross margin and burn rate, updated daily from the underlying transaction systems.
Breaks out revenue and expenses by business segment for external disclosure requirements, keeping segment definitions consistent quarter to quarter.
Lets external auditors trace a number on a financial statement back through every supporting transaction and approval.
Routes vendor invoices through the right approval chain based on amount and cost center before they're queued for payment.
Batches approved vendor payments into a single disbursement run each week, choosing ACH, wire, or check per vendor preference.
Tracks cumulative payments to contractors and vendors throughout the year to determine 1099 filing obligations at year end.
Identifies vendor invoices eligible for an early payment discount and recommends which ones to pay ahead of schedule to capture savings.
Gives vendors a portal to see which invoices were included in a payment and download a remittance advice for their own reconciliation.
